parameters.prompt: The exact snake-tailed demon lady in the reference draws in spirit energy to heal herself in place. From the resting pose she slowly crosses both hands over her chest, closes her eyes and bows her head, the upper body rising and sinking gently with deep slow breaths while the coiled tail stays on the ground, holds this calm meditative pose for a long time, then opens her arms slightly, lifts her head and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The tail stays coiled and does not slither or move across the ground. She stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and one snake tail. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character, the tail tip and the hair stay inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, headdress, clothing and scaled tail. No slithering, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: settle into the pose over the first second, hold the breathing meditation until four seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
